questions.stem: A circle has a radius of 7 cm. What is its circumference in terms of pi?
questions.explanation: C = 2 pi r = 2 x pi x 7 = 14 pi cm. A common error is to use pi r^2 (the area formula) instead.

questions.stem: A circular pond has a diameter of 8 m. A path goes around the full edge. How long is the path to 1 decimal place?
questions.explanation: C = pi x d = pi x 8 = 25.1327... which rounds to 25.1 m.

questions.stem: A bicycle wheel has a circumference of 200 cm. What is the diameter of the wheel to the nearest cm?
questions.explanation: C = pi x d, so d = C / pi = 200 / pi = 63.66... which rounds to 64 cm.

questions.stem: What is the perimeter of a semicircle with diameter 10 cm? Give your answer to 1 decimal place.
questions.explanation: Perimeter of a semicircle = half the circumference + the diameter = (1/2) x pi x 10 + 10 = 5 pi + 10 = 15.707... + 10 = 25.7 cm (1 d.p.).

questions.stem: A wheel with radius 35 cm makes 100 complete rotations. What total distance does it cover? Give your answer to the nearest metre.
questions.explanation: Circumference = 2 pi r = 2 x pi x 35 = 70 pi cm. In 100 rotations: 100 x 70 pi = 7000 pi = 21,991 cm = 219.91 m, which rounds to 220 m.
